items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 9:1
items.html: (To the question) In ZON, all four states apply: Achor be Achor [back to back], Achor be Panim [back to face], Panim be Achor [face to back], and Panim be Panim [face to face]. But in AVI, the aspect of Achor be Panim does not apply; only Achor be Achor, Panim be Achor, and Panim be Panim apply. (p. 502, Item 25. And in Inner Light, entry "in AVI.")
